title: Calculate specific interfacial energy
action: Using the provided lattice constants aγ (austenite) and aM23C6 for each alloy (25Cr-20Ni-Nb-N and 22Cr-25Ni-Mo-Nb-N), the elastic modulus formula Eγ = 254680 - 114.76*T (T in Kelvin), Poisson ratio ν = 0.29, linear thermal expansion coefficient α = 2.21e-5 K⁻¹, compute the specific interfacial energy σ between M23C6 and austenite at 25°C (298.15 K) and 700°C (973.15 K) using the misfit dislocation model: misfit δ = |aM23C6 - 3*aγ| / aM23C6; Burgers vector b = aγ/√2; correction factor f(δ) = δ * (2/(1+1/(4δ^2)) - ln(2δ)); σ = (Eγ * aγ) / (4√2*(1-ν^2)) * f(δ). For the 700°C case, adjust the room-temperature lattice constants for thermal expansion first. Output a CSV file with the four results.
description: Computed specific interfacial energy σ (J/m²) for 25Cr-20Ni-Nb-N and 22Cr-25Ni-Mo-Nb-N at 25°C and 700°C.
output_schema: CSV with columns: alloy (string), temperature_C (int), sigma (float). Four rows.
